title: Lost Mary BM600 Watermelon Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Watermelon Ice combines the sweet, mellow taste of ripe Watermelon with a fresh streak of cooling Menthol. The flavour delivers light, juicy fruit notes on the inhale with a brisk exhale that adds lift and refreshment. Smooth and vibrant, this profile is ideal for vapers who enjoy chilled tropical flavours with a clean finish. Each twin pack includes two prefilled 2ml pods containing 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, designed for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit. The nic salt formula ensures a smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw with rapid nicotine absorption. Each pod provides up to 600 puffs depending on your vaping style. When empty, simply click in a replacement to keep the experience going.
